public_gates: M807 implements and runs only no-training axis expansion
M807 preserves the P0 human-view actor contract
M807 keeps alpha 0.2 and the primary <=0.00005 margin threshold unchanged
M807 requires source-diversity and axis-diversity before pass
M807 confirms actor and M761 residual-head checksums unchanged
M807 blocks residual calibration, PPO, and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor or residual parameters
do not train a new residual calibrator
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs
do not widen the primary 0.00005 margin threshold
do not weaken seed source or fault dominance thresholds
do not treat M804 half-width rows alone as source-diverse pass
do not post-process margins after rollout
do not tune from private holdout failures

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether lateral source-step fault-axis and bracketed retargeting can overcome M804's one-axis dominance
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-training corpus implementation only; no residual calibration PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if accepted rows are absent
stop if accepted rows are source concentrated
stop if accepted rows are retarget-axis concentrated
stop if rows only pass by metric post-processing
stop if actor or residual checksums change
fallback_plan: if axis expansion is sparse, audit before more retargeting
if axis expansion remains geometry-only, use M804/M807 rows only as limited debug corpus or write synthesis
if corpus passes, route to audit before any active-steer calibration

hypothesis: Adding lateral, source-step, fault-axis, and bracketed retargeting can produce source-diverse and axis-diverse primary low-margin rows without weakening the gate.
success_criteria: M807 writes axis anchor, plan, replay, accepted, rejected, balance, bracket, progress, summary, and documentation artifacts
M807 reports accepted rows, unique seeds, source indices, fault-family pairs, retarget axes, and dominance metrics
M807 confirms actor and residual-head checksums unchanged
M807 classifies the result without widening the primary margin gate
M807 keeps residual calibration, PPO, and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: implementation trains actor, residual head, or a new calibrator
implementation omits source-diversity or axis-diversity diagnostics
implementation treats M804 half-width rows as primary-pass evidence without axis diversity
implementation changes margin by post-processing rather than closed-loop replay

decision_rule: M807 may implement and run only no-training boundary-axis expansion. It must not train actor or residual parameters, run PPO, or promote a checkpoint.
